en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Salma Bin Al Khattab, from Al Hassan Bin Ali Bin Yaqteen, from Aasim Bin Humeyd, from Ibrahim Bin Abu Yahya, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> married Umm Salma<sup>as</sup>. Umar Bin Abu Salma married her<sup>as</sup> to him<sup>saww</sup>, and he was young and had yet to attain puberty’.
en.sarwar: 6. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘ Umayr from Hammad from al-Halabiy who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
The Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, did not marry a second wife in Khadijah’s lifetime.’”
